description: Source code for an authentication and authorization API router using FastAPI, defining endpoints for user registration, login, role assignment, profile retrieval, and registration toggling.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Request model for user registration containing username, password, and roles.

classes.name: RegisterResponse
classes.description: Response model for successful user registration.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Request model for user login containing username and password.

classes.name: LoginResponse
classes.description: Response model for login containing access token details.

classes.name: AssignRoleRequest
classes.description: Request model for assigning a role to a user.

classes.name: AssignRoleResponse
classes.description: Response model after assigning a role to a user.

classes.name: UserProfileResponse
classes.description: Response model for user profile details.

classes.name: ToggleRegistrationRequest
classes.description: Request model for toggling registration enabled/disabled.

methods.name: register_user
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, with runtime toggle for registration enabled status.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate a user and return a bearer token.

methods.name: assign_role
methods.description: Endpoint to assign an additional role to an existing user.

methods.name: get_me
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve current authenticated user's profile.

methods.name: toggle_registration
methods.description: Endpoint to enable or disable user registration at runtime, admin only.
